description: What was agreed on a task, as a document you can hash: title, description, acceptance criteria, the conduct the requester declares the work may use, and where it is aimed. sha256 of its canonical JSON is the digest a claim answer hands you, so the deal is checkable rather than quotable. `history` is every earlier wording, kept because a pin on one of them is a pin on words somebody read.
name: task_terms
